IIT Madras has a huge campus area, infrastructure, and many renowned facilities. It has 16 departments and a few advanced research centers with the latest lab equipment. Therefore, it offers a decent number of 9 UG courses, a huge number of 31 PG courses, and 25 dual degree courses.


Since IIT Madras is a world-renowned institution, it is the top-most destination for every engineering aspirant to study in this institution. Therefore, it is important to know all the details, particularly the fee structure for UG courses. So, here are the fee details.
